# Snyk

> Snyk is an AI-driven developer security platform that secures code, dependencies, containers, and infrastructure throughout the software development lifecycle.

Snyk provides comprehensive application security solutions with AI-powered vulnerability detection, automated remediation, and security intelligence. The platform integrates with major development tools and CI/CD pipelines to enable shift-left security practices.

## Key Topics

- AI Security Fabric
- SAST (Static Application Security Testing)
- SCA (Software Composition Analysis)
- Container Security
- Infrastructure as Code Security
- DAST (Dynamic Application Security Testing)
- DevSecOps
- Vulnerability Management
- Software Supply Chain Security
- DeepCode AI
- Snyk Code
- Risk-Based Prioritization
- IDE Integration
- CI/CD Integration
- Developer Security Training

## Platform & Core Products

- [Snyk AI Security Platform](https://snyk.io/platform): Main platform covering DevSecOps, vulnerability prevention, and AI governance for secure development
- [Snyk Homepage](https://snyk.io): Snyk AI Security Fabric for secure code, models, and agents
- [Snyk Code](https://snyk.io/product/snyk-code): SAST code scanning tool with auto-fix and IDE integration for code security analysis
- [DeepCode AI](https://snyk.io/platform/deepcode-ai): AI code review and autofix powered by GPT-4 for SAST vulnerability detection
- [Snyk Studio](https://snyk.io/product/studio): AI development lifecycle platform for preventing vulnerabilities in AI-generated code

## Security Scanning & Management

- [Open Source Security Management](https://snyk.io/product/open-source-security-management): SCA tool for dependency scanning and open source vulnerability management
- [Container Vulnerability Management](https://snyk.io/product/container-vulnerability-management): Kubernetes and Docker security with vulnerability scanning for container images
- [Infrastructure as Code Security](https://snyk.io/product/infrastructure-as-code-security): IaC security scanning for Terraform, CloudFormation, and Kubernetes configurations
- [DAST Tool](https://snyk.io/product/dast-api-web): Dynamic application security testing for API and web application security with AI
- [Security Intelligence Platform](https://snyk.io/platform/security-intelligence): Industry-leading vulnerability data and threat detection insights with proprietary research

## AI-Driven Workflows & Solutions

- [Snyk AI Workflow](https://snyk.io/platform/workflows): AI-driven SDLC security solutions with Snyk Assist and Agent Fix for automated remediation
- [Secure AI-Generated Code](https://snyk.io/solutions/secure-ai-generated-code): Solution for securing AI-generated code with SAST scanning and automated auto-fix
- [Application Security Solutions](https://snyk.io/solutions/application-security): Comprehensive AppSec solution covering code, dependencies, containers, and infrastructure
- [Software Supply Chain Security](https://snyk.io/solutions/software-supply-chain-security): Supply chain security with SBOM generation, vulnerability management, and shift-left practices

## Integration & Workflow

- [Snyk Integrations](https://snyk.io/integrations): Integration hub for SDLC tools, CI/CD platforms, IDEs, and partner solutions

## Developer Resources & Training

- [Snyk Learn](https://snyk.io/platform/snyk-learn): Developer security training platform covering OWASP Top 10 and secure coding practices
- [AI Code Checker](https://snyk.io/code-checker): Free AI-powered code checker for vulnerability detection and code analysis

## Vulnerability Management & Prioritization

- [Zero-Day Vulnerability Security](https://snyk.io/solutions/zero-day-vulnerability-security): Zero-day vulnerability detection and remediation using Snyk Vulnerability Database
- [Risk-Based Prioritization](https://snyk.io/solutions/risk-based-prioritization): Risk-based prioritization using CVSS and EPSS scores for efficient vulnerability remediation

## Pricing & Plans

- [Snyk Plans and Pricing](https://snyk.io/plans): Pricing plans and subscription tiers from free to enterprise with comprehensive feature comparison
